parameters.help_en:
The asset type for synchronization. Default value: ecs. Valid values:
cloud_product: Cloud service
ecs: Server
container_image: Container image
cloud_k8s: Multi-cloud Kubernetes clusters and nodes. If you specify this value, you must also specify Vendor and ClientToken. The API only accepts asynchronous tasks. You can call the GetCloudK8sSyncTask operation to query the result
parameters.help_zh:
同步的资产类型。默认ecs。取值：
cloud_product：云产品
ecs：服务器
container_image：容器镜像
cloud_k8s：多云 Kubernetes 集群与节点。此类型须同时传入 Vendor 和 ClientToken，接口只受理异步任务，使用 GetCloudK8sSyncTask 查询执行结果
parameters.name: asset_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the cloud service. Valid values:

0: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) server
1: Server Load Balancer (SLB)
3: ApsaraDB RDS
4: ApsaraDB for MongoDB
5: Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible)
6: Container Registry
8: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK)
9: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
11: ActionTrail
12: Content Delivery Network (CDN)
13: SSL Certificates Service
14: Apsara DevOps
15: Resource Access Management (RAM)
16: Anti-DDoS
17: Web Application Firewall (WAF)
18: Object Storage Service (OSS)
19: PolarDB
20: ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL
21: Microservices Engine (MSE)
22: Apsara File Storage NAS
23: Data Security Center (DSC)
24: Elastic IP Address (EIP)
parameters.help_zh:
云产品类型。取值：

0：云服务器
1：负载均衡
3：云数据库 RDS
4：云数据库 MongoDB 版
5：云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）
6：容器镜像服务
8：容器服务Kubernetes版
9：专有网络VPC
11：操作审计
12：CDN
13：数字证书管理服务（原SSL证书
14：云效
15：访问控制
16：DDoS防护
17：Web应用防火墙
18：对象存储
19：云原生关系型数据库 PolarDB
20：云数据库 PostgreSQL
21：服务引擎
22：文件存储NAS
23：数据安全中心
24：弹性公网IP
parameters.name: cloud_asset_type

parameters.help_en:
The subtype of the cloud service.

For more information about valid values, see the following list
parameters.help_zh:
云产品子类型。

取值参考以下列表
parameters.name: cloud_asset_sub_type

parameters.help_en:
The cloud provider of the server. Valid values:

0: Alibaba Cloud assets
1: Assets outside Alibaba Cloud
2: IDC assets
3, 4, 5, and 7: Assets on other cloud platforms
8: Simple Application Server assets
parameters.help_zh:
服务器厂商。取值：

0：阿里云资产
1：云外资产
2：IDC资产
3、4、5、7：其它云资产
8：轻量级资产
parameters.name: vendor

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the authorization records. You can specify up to 1,000 IDs. This parameter is only used when AssetType is set to cloud_k8s. If you do not specify this parameter or specify an empty array, all available authorizations for the specified cloud provider under the current tenant are selected
parameters.help_zh: 授权记录 ID，最多 1000 项；仅 cloud_k8s 使用，未传或空数组选择当前租户该厂商全部可用授权
parameters.name: auth_ids

parameters.help_en: The regions of the cloud provider. You can specify up to 1,000 regions. This parameter is only used when AssetType is set to cloud_k8s. If you do not specify this parameter or specify an empty array, the regions are expanded by using the region API
parameters.help_zh: 云厂商地域，最多 1000 项；仅 cloud_k8s 使用，未传或空数组通过地域接口展开
parameters.name: scope_ids

parameters.help_en: The locators of the cloud provider clusters. You can specify up to 1,000 locators. This parameter is only used when AssetType is set to cloud_k8s. If you do not specify this parameter or specify an empty array, it indicates full coverage of the region
parameters.help_zh: 厂商集群 locator，最多 1000 项；仅 cloud_k8s 使用，未传或空数组才表示地域完整覆盖
parameters.name: cluster_ids

parameters.help_en: The idempotency key that is 1 to 128 characters in length. This parameter is required when AssetType is set to cloud_k8s. For other asset types, this parameter is optional and validated by the backend based on specific conditions
parameters.help_zh: cloud_k8s 必填的 1..128 字符幂等键；其他资产类型仍可不传，由后端条件校验
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is one of the resource directory member accounts.
You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号 ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

Accepted.description_en: Indicates whether the cloud_k8s task has been persistently accepted. This does not indicate that the task has been completed
Accepted.description_zh: cloud_k8s 任务已持久化受理，不表示执行完成
Accepted.title_en: cloud_k8s 任务已持久化受理，不表示执行完成
Accepted.title_zh: cloud_k8s 任务已持久化受理，不表示执行完成

ClientToken.description_en: The idempotency key for the cloud_k8s synchronization request, which is the same as the ClientToken in the request. If the acceptance result is uncertain, you can use the original value to query the task and avoid generating a new key for repeated submissions
ClientToken.description_zh: cloud_k8s 同步请求对应的幂等键，与请求中的 ClientToken 一致。发生受理结果不确定时，可使用原值查询任务，避免生成新键重复提交

Code.description_en: The business result code of the request. A value of 200 indicates that the request was successful. If the request fails, a business error code is returned
Code.description_zh: 本次请求的业务结果码。200 表示请求处理成功；失败时返回相应的业务错误码

ExecutionStatus.description_en: The status of the cloud_k8s asynchronous task. The status is typically ACCEPTED when the task is accepted
ExecutionStatus.description_zh: cloud_k8s 异步任务状态，受理通常为 ACCEPTED
ExecutionStatus.title_en: cloud_k8s 异步任务状态，受理通常为 ACCEPTED
ExecutionStatus.title_zh: cloud_k8s 异步任务状态，受理通常为 ACCEPTED

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code returned by the backend. If the request is successful, the value is 200. If the request fails, a corresponding status code is returned. This status code does not indicate the status of an asynchronous task
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: 后端返回的 HTTP 状态码。成功时为 200；失败时返回相应状态码，不能替代异步任务状态

Message.description_en: The business result message of the request. If the request is successful, the value is successful. If the request fails, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 本次请求的业务结果说明。成功时为 successful，失败时返回相应的错误说明

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is generated by Alibaba Cloud and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Reused.description_en: Indicates whether the idempotency key for the cloud_k8s task was reused for the same task
Reused.description_zh: cloud_k8s 幂等键是否复用了同一任务
Reused.title_en: cloud_k8s 幂等键是否复用了同一任务
Reused.title_zh: cloud_k8s 幂等键是否复用了同一任务

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. A value of true indicates that the request was successful. A value of false indicates that the request failed. For asynchronous synchronization tasks, a value of true does not indicate that the task has been completed
Success.description_zh: 本次接口请求是否处理成功。true 表示请求处理成功，false 表示失败；对于异步同步任务，不代表任务已经执行完成
